recentItems.title: Hayden Panettiere’s Rep Details “Complex” Case After Cause of Death | E! News
recentItems.description:
The search for answers surrounding Hayden Panettiere’s death is still underway. After the Greenville County Coroner’s Office ruled that the Heroes actress accidentally died from “toxic effects” of fentanyl and four other substances, further referring to the manner of death as an accident, her rep confirmed authorities are still looking into the situation. “The investigation remains ongoing and the circumstances surrounding the case are complex,” Kasey Kitchen told E! News in a Sept. 22 statement. “We must all continue to remain patient and allow the investigative process to unfold.” When first responders were dispatched to the home in South Carolina where Panettiere died Aug. 16, they treated her for a possible overdose, according to 911 dispatch calls obtained by People and TMZ. Her on again, off again boyfriend Brian Hickerson and his brother Zach Hickerson were on the scene when she died. recentItems.title: Pamela Anderson Breaks Her No-Makeup Rule With Milan Fashion Week Glam | E! News
recentItems.description:
Pamela Anderson hasn't retired her mascara just yet. The Baywatch alum skirted her makeup-free rule by going full glam at the Vogue World show during Milan Fashion Week Sept. 22. With her signature blonde hair styled in side-swept curls, Anderson rocked jet black liner and gray eyeshadow for a smokey eye, as well as light pink lipstick. The 59-year-old capped off her look with a golden lamé maxi dress from Ferragamo, which she paired with a large chain necklace, a bangle bracelet and a cocktail ring. This marked one of the rare times Anderson opted to wear makeup on the red carpet since 2023, when she swore off "doing big makeup looks."
